questions.q: What core problem does Functional Setup Manager solve?
options: It narrows Oracle Fusion's enormous set of possible setup tasks down to the ones that match your chosen offerings and functional areas
It replaces the need for a chart of accounts
It calculates currency conversion rates
It generates journal entries automatically
questions.explain: FSM takes your choice of offerings and functional areas and generates exactly the matching task list, including prerequisites.

options: A single setup task
The named container FSM uses to hold a generated, trackable task list for a rollout
A type of chart of accounts value set
A legal entity's registered address
questions.explain: An implementation project is created by selecting offerings and functional areas, and FSM builds the hierarchical task list inside it.

questions.q: What does Oracle recommend about how many offerings one implementation project should span?
options: As many as possible, to minimize the number of projects
Exactly zero offerings
No more than one offering where practical, since multi-offering projects are harder to export and hand off
Offerings are irrelevant to implementation projects
questions.explain: Oracle's guidance is to scope an implementation project to one offering wherever practical, for easier export, import, and environment hand-off.

questions.q: What can be tracked on each task within a generated FSM task list?
options: A conversion rate type
A cross-validation rule
Only whether it exists or not
An owner, a status such as not started/in progress/complete, and notes
questions.explain: FSM task lists are tracking tools: tasks can be assigned an owner, given a status, and annotated with notes.

questions.q: What guarantee does the predefined offering top task list give you about task order?
options: Tasks are listed alphabetically with no regard for dependency
It reflects the correct dependency order, so prerequisite tasks (like chart of accounts before ledger) appear in the right sequence
It randomizes task order to test consultants
It only ever contains one task at a time
questions.explain: The offering top task list already reflects prerequisite relationships, so dependent tasks like the chart of accounts appear before tasks that need them, such as Manage Ledger.
